drivers: five small features with strong consistency between tickets, messages and statuses
no independent scaling or release need
no installs or network approved, so standard-library only

alternatives.reason: Separate ticket and FAQ services would add network calls and deployables for a tiny app with one team
Suggestions are computed synchronously when a ticket is viewed; the only async candidate (email replies, M04) is deferred
No existing system must stay separate
Worth revisiting if M04 email delivery is added later: a queued email sender beside the monolith

style.reason: Simplest design that meets every driver; module boundaries keep tickets and FAQ separable

stack.frontend: Server-rendered HTML with one small CSS file; no build step
stack.hosting: Local or any host that can run Python; deployment not planned

reasons.backend: D01: B is Python and may be adapted; A's code may not be reused so it is rebuilt either way; standard library needs no install (none approved)
reasons.frontend: D02: a few agent screens; server-rendered HTML needs no toolchain
reasons.database: D03: one-file relational store with constraints and foreign keys; no service to run
reasons.tests: D04: unittest ships with Python and works with run_tests.py --unittest

modules.name: config
modules.responsibility: Read every setting from environment variables with development defaults

modules.name: accounts
modules.responsibility: Users, password sign-in, sessions, roles and the single permission check

modules.name: tickets
modules.responsibility: Tickets, statuses, messages, replies and closing

modules.name: faq

modules.name: suggestions
modules.responsibility: Rank FAQ entries against a ticket's text

modules.name: web
modules.responsibility: HTTP routing, JSON API, HTML pages, error shape

entities.name: User
entities.notes: No source has accounts; 'agent' in A maps to role agent

entities.name: Ticket
entities.notes: A's embedded messages array becomes Message rows

entities.name: Message
entities.notes: A's 'from' label becomes author_id plus the author's role

auth.method: email and password (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 600000 iterations, per-user salt)
auth.session: random token in an http-only, SameSite=Lax cookie (Secure outside development); only its SHA-256 hash stored; 12-hour expiry

configuration.HELPDESK_SECRET_KEY: random string for CSRF tokens (no default outside development)

slices.name: Ticket loop: customer opens a ticket, agent replies, agent closes
FAQ entries and suggested answers on a ticket

decisions.reason: B adaptable; A rebuilt anyway; no installs approved

decisions.decision: SQLite with foreign keys and check constraints

decisions.reason: See style; one team, strong consistency

decisions.decision: Nothing copied from A's folder; configuration via env vars and a names-only .env.example
decisions.reason: Licence unconfirmed and the folder carries live credentials and hostile hooks

decisions.decision: Suggestions ranked, capped at 3, never auto-sent
Status transitions: customer ticket/message -> pending, agent reply -> open, close only from open
REST /api/v1, JSON, error shape {error: {code, message}}, page/per_page pagination, session cookie on every endpoint except sign-in

decisions.reason: Neither source stores data; B's one FAQ entry is seeded in a fresh database
